open_findings.title: Late ancestor symlink accepted after final root ancestor preflight
open_findings.reproduction: Real Linux rename common base to .old and symlink old base to original tree immediately before fifth root open. Leaf root identities remain equal; provision returns success. Independent expected-denial test fails.
open_findings.impact: No-symlink namespace invariant violated; anchored writes remain on original opened roots. No foreign-root write/disclosure demonstrated.
open_findings.required_fix: Revalidate all ancestor no-symlink conditions and required root UID/mode/identity before successful return; preserve partial-birth nonreuse and anchored writes.

limitations: EIO injections are deterministic real-filesystem syscall fault controls, not power loss or SIGKILL
